name: Summarize a GitHub PR as an HTML Report
query: Make this PR readable as HTML: https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/pull/<number>
expected_behavior: Step 1: Parse the URL to extract host, org, repo, and PR number
Step 2: Fetch PR metadata and diff via gh pr view <URL> --json ... and gh pr diff <URL>
Step 3: Classify as Category 2 (Code Review), composing in Category 8 elements for risks
Step 4: Summarize what changed and why per logical change group (1-3 sentences each)
Step 6: Report file path to user
success_criteria: Skill activates when user provides a GitHub PR or commit URL
Correctly parses org, repo, and PR number from the URL (including GitHub Enterprise hosts)
Summarizes changes rather than reproducing the full diff
Inline diff snippets appear only when small (< 5 lines) and tied to a finding or risk
Surfaces risks and open questions, not just a restatement of the PR description
Person names are wrapped in .redacted spans
HTML is self-contained with no external dependencies
